name: Ella Newton
bio: Ella K. Newton (born December 7, 2000) is an Australian actress and filmmaker. She is best known for her role as Heather in the horror film Dangerous Animals (2025).

credits.title: Evil Dead Wrath

credits.title: Mr. Irrelevant
credits.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

credits.title: The Mosquito Bowl
credits.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

credits.title: Ode
credits.overview: Isolated in the confines of her home, Lou tries to shed the skin of her past relationship. But when she is confronted by an unknown voice that challenges her memory, her sense of self begins to unravel.

credits.title: Dangerous Animals
credits.overview: A savvy and free-spirited surfer is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer. Held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

credits.title: Girl at the Window
credits.overview: A troubled teenage girl who’s struggling to cope with the accidental death of her father suspects that the mysterious killer stalking her hometown is not only her neighbour but her mother’s new romantic interest.
